os.environ['PROJECT_ROOT']=str(repo)
import hydra
from omegaconf import OmegaConf
OmegaConf.register_new_resolver('eval',eval,replace=True)
from napari_dare3d import _api as api
from dare3d.metrics import object_level as obj
from unittest.mock import patch
from scipy.optimize import linear_sum_assignment
cfg=api._load_inference_cfg(str(cfgdir),str(movies['movie_I2'][0].parent),'cpu',checkpoint_path=str(ckpt))
cfg.data.test_data.load_labels=True
cfg.data.test_data.label_folder=str(movies['movie_I2'][1].parent)
ds=large_stack(lambda:api._build_dataset(cfg,'segmentation'))
large_stack(ds.make_masks)
truth=ds.movies_masks[0].copy(); truth[:2]=0
annotation_centers=np.array([(t,*np.mean(pair,axis=0)) for t,pairs in enumerate(ds.movies_bipoints[0]) if t>=2 for pair in pairs],dtype=float)
np.save(out/'movie_I2_truth_raw.npy',truth)
np.save(out/'movie_I2_annotation_centers.npy',annotation_centers)
raw=tifffile.memmap(legacy/'movie_I2.tif')
prob=np.swapaxes(raw,-1,-3)
save('movie_I2_truth_inventory.json',{'raw_bipoints_per_frame':[len(v) for v in ds.movies_bipoints[0]],'eligible_annotations':len(annotation_centers),'raw_shape':ds.movies_im[0].shape,'time_padding':ds.time_axis_padding,'target_shape':ds._compute_target_shape(ds.movies_im[0].shape,'movie_I2'),'reader_data_matches_tifffile':np.array_equal(ds.movies_im[0],np.swapaxes(tifffile.imread(movies['movie_I2'][0]),-1,-3))})
del ds,truth; gc.collect()
truth=np.load(out/'movie_I2_truth_raw.npy',mmap_mode='r')
runs=[
('archived',True,0.55,0.15),
('no_dilation_only',False,0.55,0.15),
('threshold_only',True,0.5,0.15),
('weight_only',True,0.55,0.1),
('napari_ge',False,0.5,0.1),
]
for name,dilate,threshold,weighted in runs:
    print('BEGIN',name,flush=True); started=time.perf_counter()
    ctx=patch.object(obj,'dilate_img',lambda x:x) if not dilate else patch.object(obj,'dilate_img',obj.dilate_img)
    with ctx:
        metrics, info=large_stack(lambda:obj.evaluate_at_object_level(prob,truth,float(threshold),float(weighted),distance_mode='iou',distance_threshold=1e-6))
    centers=np.asarray(info['pred_ccs_stats']['centroids'])
    save('archived_'+name+'.json',{'metrics':metrics,'threshold':threshold,'weighted_cutoff':weighted,'dilation':dilate,'elapsed_seconds':time.perf_counter()-started,'pred_centers_txyz':centers,'pred_sizes':info['pred_ccs_stats']['voxel_counts'],'pred_mean_probability':info['pred_ccs_stats']['mean_prob'],'true_centers_txyz':info['true_ccs_stats']['centroids'],'matches':info['matched_items'],'eligible_annotation_count':len(annotation_centers)})
    print(name,json.dumps(metrics), 'centers',len(centers), 'seconds',round(time.perf_counter()-started,2),flush=True)
    del info,centers; gc.collect()
def actual_napari_extract():
    with patch.object(api,'_build_model',return_value=None), patch.object(api,'_build_dataset',return_value=None),patch.object(api,'segmentation_inference',return_value=[raw]):
        return api._segment(cfg,'cpu',overlap=0.25,batch_size=4,threshold=0.5,min_weighted_prob=0.1)
print('BEGIN actual Napari extraction',flush=True)
centers=large_stack(actual_napari_extract)
save('archived_napari_actual_centers.json',{'centers_mtxyz':centers,'n':len(centers),'raw_probability_equal_half_voxels':int(np.count_nonzero(raw==0.5))})
print('actual Napari centers',len(centers),flush=True)
